name: meshferry
description: Meshferry is a self-hostable tunnel service with a Clerk-backed dashboard, terminal device linking, and HTTP/TCP/UDP edge forwarding.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @meshferry/core && npm run build -w @meshferry/gateway && npm run build -w @meshferry/cli && npm run build -w @meshferry/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @meshferry/core && npm run typecheck -w @meshferry/gateway && npm run typecheck -w @meshferry/cli && npm run typecheck -w @meshferry/web
